milestone: Indefinite auto-fill columns and intrinsic block allocation in selected ordinary, flex and grid flows
publication: Branch checkpoint scope only. No PR, merge, signing, package publication or deployment for this batch.

implementation.owner: OfficeIMO.Html shared column planner, flow-block allocation and ordinary/flex/grid consumers
changes: Indefinite continuous auto-fill follows sequential content flow, with min/max height and box-sizing constraints handled by the existing size owner.
Selected flex and grid flows retain natural item allocation while physical-page column bands project their content.
Ordinary wrapper decoration and following flow retain their allocation through fragmented child projection.
Unsupported column break declarations preserve source content and produce typed fidelity diagnostics.

publicPath: HtmlSiteBundle.Load -> HtmlRenderRequest.Create -> HtmlRenderEngine.Execute / bundle.RenderToPdfResult -> ExportImages; exact bundled fonts, Browser UA, portable resources, no host font fallback.

frameworks.boundary: Full Category!=Performance correctness suites pass on .NET8/.NET10. Actual subject modules and complete TRX retained; standalone full test hosts/build graphs are regenerable.

findings.contract: Ordinary column-flex wrappers retain paint through the original allocated height after child columns project into physical page bands.
findings.evidence: The reviewed candidate retained the 124 px wrapper allocation but painted its box at 105 px: native page-3 bottom border Y=43, managed Y=24, with AFTER at Y=44 in both. The correction retains the full allocated paint height; final whole-page comparisons and 24 border-page controls pass.

review.productApiDisposition: Accept internal shape after wrapper correction and decisive proof; canonical HTML layout owner, no public API/dependency expansion.
validationGaps: Thirteen controls lack native continuous DOM geometry; five controls remain outside native-parity acceptance.
External CI, Windows profiling and public release are outside this branch checkpoint.
review.confirmation: Independent reviewer confirmed capacity19 bottom border now matches native, existing wrapped/grid/margin controls show no sibling regression; accept as shaped.

directRenderChecks.boundary: Canonical PNG matches independently generated, reopened PDF in print, screen-media paged and screen-snapshot profiles. Direct scene PNG is a separate renderer. Source labels are checked once in both paged PDFs and the continuous scene; snapshot PDFs embed a raster.

native.engine: Microsoft Edge 155 on macOS through existing HtmlTinkerX 3.0.4 / Playwright 1.63 qualification tools

boundaryCases.limitation: Short balanced max-height creates more horizontal columns than fit the authored width; native continuous and paged overflow ownership differ. Managed source-preserving AFTER placement stays explicit; no native-parity acceptance claim.
Authored short max-height can overflow sideways; native paged output may clip or shrink off-page columns. No native-parity acceptance claim.
A short border-box max-height leaves less than a full pair of source lines per column; native paged overflow/clipping/scaling remains an explicit boundary.
A definite zero-length flex basis produces short-height horizontal overflow; native paged clipping/scaling remains an explicit boundary.
Pre-existing unsupported forced column break; the selected behavior is source-preserving typed fallback. Never count this case as native column-break support.

continuousDomEvidence.boundary: These thirteen native captures contain no ID-based DOM boxes. They do not qualify native continuous geometry; paged PDF evidence is assessed separately.
continuousDomEvidence.comparison: ID-backed text positions and AFTER geometry within 0.1 CSS px. The thirteen initial inputs without IDs do not count as native continuous-geometry acceptance.

native.method: Use exact input/font bytes, source multiplicity, page/column and bbox checks, and unmasked raster comparisons. Native DOM geometry, native paged appearance and renderer replay remain separate proof. No pixel-parity claim.

svg.boundary: Exact public vector SVG bytes isolated as intrinsic-size image documents in Edge. Root inspected all36 pages in ten normal96dpi contact sheets; no pixel identity claim.

wrapperPaint.boundary: Additional exact authored blue-border bounds/horizontal-edge check; unmasked whole-page raster differences are retained separately.

visualInspection.result: Root inspected retained whole-page comparisons; independent reviewer inspected wrapper remediation and sibling controls. Small text-antialiasing differences remain; no pixel-identity claim.

packages.retainedPackageAndRuntimeArchive: package-proof/feed and package-proof/out retain actual qualified package bytes and executed managed/native consumers.
packages.boundary: Only Html package is repacked at current source. Four dependency-owner trees and shared build inputs are unchanged; exact previously qualified private owner packages are reused. Legacy assets are built, not executed. No signing, package publication or Windows profiling.

broaderReports.boundary: Managed regression against protected prior reports; no new native report appearance acceptance.

remainingBoundary: The five named native boundary controls remain outside native-parity acceptance; the forced-column-break control exercises source-preserving typed fallback rather than column-break support.
Thirteen initial native captures have no DOM boxes and remain outside native continuous-geometry qualification.

Spanning and nested column regions, transformed/vertical regions, atomic/floating hosts, tall column notes and figures, changing page geometry and height-dependent alignment retain their separate qualification boundaries.
Native text antialiasing and general unfamiliar-page acceptance remain distinct from the selected geometry controls.

reproduction.fixtures: Copy one selected checked-in HTML fixture and the two exact repository fonts from assetMap into a temporary directory as index.html, regular.ttf and bold.ttf. Serve over loopback for native capture or load the three entries into HtmlSiteBundle for managed execution.
reproduction.managedConfiguration: Browser UA; exact bundled Witness regular/bold fonts; no host font fallback or external resources; ViewportWidth=800, ViewportHeight=1000; HonorCssPageRules; CSS page size 700 x 140 px with 20 px margins.
reproduction.nativeConfiguration: HtmlTinkerX BrowserProbe with Microsoft Edge 155; wait for document.fonts and images; collect print and screen-media CSS-paged PDFs and ID-based DOM geometry at 800 x 1000. Browser error arrays are empty and server/browser sessions are released.
reproduction.pixelPolicy: Poppler at 96 dpi; all bbox edges converted once from points to CSS pixels; full unmasked raw RGB comparisons. Text geometry tolerance is 0.1 CSS px; authored blue wrapper edges are also checked within one raster pixel. Glyph antialiasing remains consumer dependent.
